name: WF-225 — Closing Coordination → Critical Dates & Milestone Monitoring

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const d=input.deal??input;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const closing_date=d.closing_date??d.target_closing_date??null;const now=d.as_of??new Date().toISOString();const milestones=Array.isArray(d.milestones)?d.milestones:[];const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];const critical=milestones.filter(m=>m.critical===true||String(m.priority??"").toLowerCase()==="critical");const overdue=milestones.filter(m=>{if(!m.due_at)return false;return new Date(m.due_at).getTime()<new Date(now).getTime()&&!["completed","verified","closed"].includes(String(m.status??"").toLowerCase());});const critical_overdue=overdue.filter(m=>critical.some(c=>(c.id&&c.id===m.id)||c.name===m.name));let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Milestone monitoring cannot proceed.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id||!closing_date){reason="Missing transaction identity or closing date.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved blockers require escalation.";}else if(critical_overdue.length){state="critical_overdue";route="WF-207";reason="Critical closing milestones are overdue.";}else if(overdue.length){state="attention_required";route="WF-207";reason="One or more closing milestones are overdue.";}else if(milestones.length&&milestones.every(m=>["completed","verified","closed"].includes(String(m.status??"").toLowerCase()))){state="milestones_completed";route="WF-206";reason="All tracked closing milestones are complete.";}else{state="on_track";route="WF-206";reason="Closing milestones are on track; continue evidence monitoring.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-225",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,closing_date,as_of:now,milestones,critical_milestones:critical,overdue_milestones:overdue,critical_overdue_milestones:critical_overdue,blockers,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:state!=="on_track"}}];
